message.content: {"status":"available","text":"实验设置：评测覆盖13个真实场景（Mip-NeRF360 全套场景、Tanks&Temples 两场景、Hedman et al. 两场景）与合成 Blender 数据集，按 Mip-NeRF360 的做法每8张取1张作测试，报告 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS；除 Mip-NeRF360 在其自身数据集上的数字为原文复制外，其余均为作者自跑(E121)(E124)。Table 1 上 Ours-30K 训练41m33s、134 FPS、PSNR 27.21，Mip-NeRF360 为 PSNR 27.69、48h、0.06 FPS，其中48h是由4-GPU A100 节点训练12h换算，且 A100 快于 A6000；帧率用基于 SIBR 的交互 viewer 测(E103)(E138)(E113)。合成场景从100K 个随机 Gaussian 初始化，自动剪枝到6–10K，30K 迭代后每场景200–500K，平均 PSNR 33.32，渲染180–300 FPS(E136)(E111)(E141)。消融 Table 3 只给出 Truck-5K、Garden-5K、Bicycle-5K、Truck-30K 的 PSNR，图像先手工降采样到统一渲染分辨率：Full 为22.71/25.82/23.18/24.81，No-Split 为18.31/23.98/22.21/20.59，No-Clone 为22.29/25.61/22.15/24.82，表明 split 影响背景重建、clone 利于细结构与更快收敛(E126)(E129)(E146)。Limited-BW（仅前10个 splat 获梯度）使 Truck 下降11dB(E162)；Isotropic 用单标量半径、损害表面贴合质量，Ficus 两配置均限5k Gaussians(E163)(E173)；No-SH 显示 SH 补偿视角相关效应(E164)；Random Init 在背景与覆盖不足区域遗留更多 floaters(E145)。","sources":["E121","E124","E103","E138","E113","E136","E111","E141","E126","E129","E146","E162","E163","E173","E164","E145"]}

Key facts:
- Datasets: 13 real scenes from previously published datasets plus synthetic Blender dataset; full set of Mip-NeRF360 scenes, two scenes Tanks&Temples, two from Hedman et al. (E121)
- train/test split: every 8th photo for test following Mip-NeRF360, metrics PSNR, L-PIPS, SSIM; all numbers from own runs of authors' code except Mip-NeRF360 on their dataset copied (E124)
- A6000 GPU; Mip-NeRF360 trained on 4-GPU A100 node for 12 hours = 48 hours single GPU (E121, E138)
- Table 1: M-NeRF360 PSNR 27.69, SSIM 0.792, LPIPS 0.237, 48h, 0.06 FPS, 8.6MB; Ours-7K 25.60/0.770/0.279, 6m25s, 160 FPS, 523MB; Ours-30K 27.21/0.815/0.214, 41m33s, 134 FPS, 734MB (E103). Also Plenoxels and INGP numbers (E101).
- FPS measured with interactive viewer SIBR (E113) — "We used this implementation to measure our achieved frame rates."
- Synthetic Blender: random init from 100K uniform random Gaussians, pruned to 6-10K, final 200-500K per scene after 30K iters, PSNR table 2, Ours-30K avg 33.32 (E111, E136, E108)
- rendering 180–300 FPS for synthetic scenes (E141)
- Ablation Table 3: per-scene PSNR columns Truck-5K, Garden-5K, Bicycle-5K, Truck-30K; rows Limited-BW, Random Init, No-Split, No-SH, No-Clone, Isotropic, Full with values (E128, E129). Note this experiment manually downsampled high-resolution versions of each scene's input images to the established rendering resolution (E126, E127).
- Ablations tested: initialization from SfM, densification strategies, anisotropic covariance, unlimited number of splats with gradients, spherical harmonics (E144)
- Initialization: random sampling cube 3x extent of input camera bounding box (E145)
- Densification: split important for background, clone better/faster convergence with thin structures (E146)
- Limited-BW: N=10, Truck scene degraded by 11dB in PSNR (E162)
- Isotropic ablation: single scalar radius (E163); Ficus restricted to no more than 5k Gaussians in both configs (E173)
- SH improves overall PSNR (E164)
- Compactness: vs Zhang et al. 2022, 2–4 minutes, one-fourth of their point count, average model size 3.8 MB vs their 9 MB, used two degrees of SH (E142)
- Note image/sample/mask counts: the excerpts don't give counts of images/samples/masks per dataset. We should say the source doesn't specify counts.
